flange-fem-stages.png.frame_selection: 863 has the largest per-frame flange FEM maximum among all 1,136 record frames in frames.bin (0.1142 MPa); 538 shows raising the torso while holding the tray and 921 shows the scene after release
flange-fem-stages.png.color_scale: viewer shader scale shared by all panels: t = ln(1 + s / 1 kPa) / ln(1 + 848.567 kPa / 1 kPa), 0 to 0.85 MPa
flange-fem-stages.png.presentation_change: robot panel and flange canvas cropped; titles, values, color bar and notes drawn with Pillow using NanumBarunGothic; first scene is labeled as lifting the torso while holding the tray (raise_high phase)
flange-fem-stages.png.cad_scope: rendered image only; STEP, BREP, mesh and structural bundle files are not included
flange-fem-stages.png.value_note: the per-scene maximum is the largest single-element von Mises value, which depends on mesh size and support condition; it is used for comparing scenes
